measures.article: Art. 1(15)(b)(i), replacing Art. 10a(1a), second subparagraph of Directive 2003/87/EC
measures.duty: Producers of CBAM-covered goods see their free allocation shrink on a fixed annual CBAM-factor schedule, falling to 0% from 2038, as CBAM replaces free allocation as the carbon-leakage instrument for those goods.

plain.title: Free carbon allowances for European steel are being withdrawn
plain.sentence: European steel makers lose their free allowances on a fixed schedule that reaches zero in 2038, which costs €2.58 per tonne of hot metal at today's carbon price and more every year after that.

caveats: The figure is the cost of the WITHDRAWN benchmark allocation, not the full carbon cost of a plant: a site emitting above the benchmark pays for its excess on top of this, and always did.
The carbon price is held flat at today's level across the whole schedule. That is an assumption, not a forecast, and the model is linear in it.

context.label: the same model on EAF carbon steel

edges.bottleneck_name: Green premium against willingness to pay
edges.note: Withdrawing free allocation raises the cost of blast-furnace steel, which narrows the gap the low-carbon product has to close.

evidence.quote: Producers of CBAM-covered goods see their free allocation shrink on a fixed annual CBAM-factor schedule, falling to 0% from 2038, as CBAM replaces free allocation as the carbon-leakage instrument for those goods.

plain.title: EU grants for making iron without coal
plain.sentence: €250 million has been awarded from the Innovation Fund to European steel projects that reduce iron ore without coal.

money.formula: sum of funding.amount where funding.under = this measure and funding.status is committed (approved, signed, disbursed)
caveats: Awarded under the Innovation Fund as it stands today (Art. 10a(8) of Directive 2003/87/EC). plain.sentence: Europe's oil and gas producers have to open, between them, enough permanent CO2 storage to meet the Union's target for 2030, each taking a share in proportion to what it produces.
